title: ZTIE sanitized-telemetry data contract (v1)
description: The derived, bounded SANITIZED BEHAVIORAL TELEMETRY produced by the Story 2.5 sanitization pipeline (RD-031) for one intake artifact detonated host-native on the ephemeral EC2, and the NINTH envelope kind on the Forensic -> Hub RD-013 gate. Story 2.4 CAPTURED the raw behavioral trace (RD-030) and kept the FULL trace in Forensic (RD-009); Story 2.5 SANITIZES that raw trace through a three-stage pipeline IN ORDER — (1) entropy scrub (redact high-entropy VALUES: keys / base64 / random blobs, keeping the behavioral STRUCTURE), (2) noise suppress (drop deterministic host/runtime noise: SSM-agent boot, dynamic-linker library loads, locale-archive opens, shell/coreutils startup), (3) <=25K-token truncation (deterministic, in trace order, with a recorded truncated flag) — into the bounded, derived view the Phase-3 Nova Pro correlation engine reasons over. The FULL raw trace stays in Forensic (RD-009); this envelope REFERENCES it via a pointer and NEVER duplicates it. All event timings are RELATIVE monotonic offsets (ms) from detonation start, never a wall clock (only the envelope 'sanitized_at' stamp is wall-clock, for audit correlation). It is NOT a verdict: there is NO verdict/safe/approved/forward/pass_fail/malicious/clean field anywhere; the sanitized events and pipeline accounting are EVIDENCE and the verdict is Hub-side/human-gated (Phase 4). Allow-list: additionalProperties false at every level; every field typed and enum/length/range-bounded; every array maxItems-capped. Integrity-keyed by intake_id + sha256. DERIVED-ONLY. OWN version pin (SANITIZED_TELEMETRY_CONTRACT_VERSION) + a UNIQUE 'sanitized' discriminator that does not collide with any other envelope kind.

contract_version.description: Sanitized-telemetry-contract schema version. Pinned SEPARATELY on the Hub validator (SANITIZED_TELEMETRY_CONTRACT_VERSION) so this envelope kind versions independently of the other eight kinds (never rides the shared CONTRACT_VERSION). The Hub rejects unknown-version envelopes fail-closed.

intake_id.description: The intake UUIDv4 this sanitized view is for. The Hub upserts the sanitized view onto the tracking record keyed by this.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the raw artifact body that was detonated. Integrity key, bound to intake_id; the Hub rejects a sanitized view whose sha256 does not match the tracked record.

sanitized_at.description: RFC3339/ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (Z-suffixed) the orchestrator finished sanitizing this run's trace in Forensic. This is the ONLY wall-clock field — all EVENT timings are relative monotonic offsets (see sanitized.events[].offset_ms).

sanitized.description: The derived, sanitized behavioral view: a pointer to the full raw trace in Forensic (RD-009), the three-stage pipeline accounting (entropy scrub / noise suppress / truncate), and the bounded, token-budgeted sanitized event sequence the Phase-3 Nova Pro correlation engine reasons over. It REFERENCES — never duplicates — the full trace. EVIDENCE only; NO verdict anywhere. When there was no raw trace to sanitize (status 'no_trace') the events array is absent but the pipeline accounting still records the gap explicitly.

lane.description: The lane this sanitized view belongs to. Always 'dynamic_detonation' (the sanitized form of the behavior captured during the dynamic run).

source.description: A POINTER to the FULL raw behavioral trace in Forensic S3 (RD-009 — the full trace stays in Forensic; only this bounded, sanitized view crosses). REFERENCES the trace, never duplicates it. Absent when there was no trace to sanitize.

capture_tool.description: The host-native capture tool whose trace was sanitized (RD-030: 'strace'), or 'none' when there was no trace.

trace_s3_bucket.description: Forensic S3 bucket holding the FULL raw behavioral trace that was sanitized. Absent when no trace was captured.

trace_s3_key.description: Forensic S3 key of the full raw behavioral trace (traces/<intake_id>/behavior-trace.txt).

raw_trace_bytes.description: Size in bytes of the raw trace that was sanitized (the pipeline input size). Bounded count; EVIDENCE of how much was cleaned.

pipeline.description: The three-stage sanitization accounting: which stages ran (in order), how much was redacted / suppressed, the token budget and the deterministic truncation outcome. EVIDENCE of what the pipeline DID to the raw trace so the transformation is auditable and reproducible. NOT a verdict.

status.description: How sanitization ended (sanitized / no_trace / sanitize_error). EVIDENCE of sanitization HEALTH — never a verdict about the artifact. A missing raw trace is RECORDED here, never a silent gap.

stages.description: The ordered sanitization stages that ran: entropy_scrub -> noise_suppress -> truncate. Records the pipeline order so the transformation is reproducible.

raw_events.description: Number of behavioral events parsed from the RAW trace before sanitization (the pipeline input size). Bounded count.

entropy_redactions.description: Number of high-entropy VALUES the entropy scrub redacted across all events (keys / base64 / random blobs replaced by a bounded marker). Bounded count.

noise_suppressed.description: Number of deterministic host/runtime-noise events the noise suppressor DROPPED (SSM-agent boot, dynamic-linker library loads, locale-archive opens, shell/coreutils startup) — NOT the artifact's own behavior. Bounded count.

kept_events.description: Number of events KEPT after noise suppression, before truncation. Bounded count.

emitted_events.description: Number of sanitized events actually EMITTED in the bounded 'events' array after truncation (<= kept_events, <= MAX_EVENTS). Bounded count.

token_budget.description: The Phase-3 token budget the sanitized view is bounded to (default 25000). Truncation keeps events in trace order until this budget is reached.

estimated_tokens.description: The DETERMINISTIC estimated token count of the emitted sanitized view (a chars/4 heuristic, never a live tokenizer call). Bounded to <= token_budget by the truncation stage.

truncated.description: True iff the <=25K-token truncation dropped one or more kept events to fit the budget (the full trace still stays in Forensic behind the pointer). A completeness fact, not a verdict. Never a silent drop.

events.description: The bounded, token-budgeted SANITIZED event sequence (in trace order): high-entropy values redacted, host/runtime noise suppressed, truncated to the token budget. The full trace stays in Forensic (RD-009). Inert EVIDENCE for Phase-3 correlation; never executed.

offset_ms.description: RELATIVE monotonic offset in milliseconds from detonation start at which this event was observed. A relative clock only (RD-031: no wall clock for behavioral timings; derived from the trace's -tt timestamps as a monotonic delta from the first line).

category.description: The behavioral category of this event (file / network / process / signal / other). Mirrors the strace syscall groups 2.4 traced.

syscall.description: The syscall name for this event (e.g. 'openat', 'connect', 'execve'). Structure is KEPT by the entropy scrub; only high-entropy VALUES inside the summary are redacted.

summary.description: The SANITIZED one-line summary of this event: the syscall's salient args with high-entropy VALUES (keys / base64 / random blobs) replaced by a bounded '[REDACTED:...]' marker and the behavioral structure (path shape, destination, flags) preserved. Byte-capped. Inert EVIDENCE, never executed / opened / dialed by the Hub.

redacted.description: True iff the entropy scrub redacted one or more high-entropy values in this event's summary. A sanitization-accounting fact, not a verdict.
